subject.title: [Bug]: nodes invoke reports raw JSON parse errors when --params is malformed

question: Which linked fix PR should be treated as the canonical landing path for the malformed `nodes invoke --params` diagnostic?
rationale: The bug is narrow and source-proven, but three open PRs target the same issue and only maintainers should choose which branch to land or supersede.

options.title: Use the proof-sufficient same-author PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101838 if its diff still matches current main, then close the duplicate candidate PRs after merge.

options.title: Choose another candidate after review
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101956 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102088 only if it proves a cleaner final diff or better validation.

recommendation.title: Use the proof-sufficient same-author PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101838 if its diff still matches current main, then close the duplicate candidate PRs after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for this CLI nodes area comes from repeated prior nodes CLI changes.
